# Hugo Narrow 2.1.3

Patch release for the v2 line. Hugo Narrow is no longer maintained; existing sites should stay on their pinned v2 release.

## Fixes

- Copying a code block now preserves indentation in minified builds. The copy source is rendered in a `<pre>` element, so Hugo's HTML minifier no longer collapses leading whitespace. (#96)
- `lineNumbersInTable: true` now keeps line numbers and code on the same baseline, including highlighted lines. The number column is sized to its content and both columns share the same font size and line height.
- Code blocks no longer inherit the Markdown table hover background inside the Chroma line-number table.
- `noClasses: true` code blocks keep their padding and horizontal scrolling instead of being clipped by the code block container.

## Notes

- Syntax colors with `noClasses: true` still use the single palette Hugo inlines. Use `noClasses: false` for light and dark syntax colors.

## Upgrade

```bash
hugo mod get github.com/tom2almighty/hugo-narrow/v2@v2.1.3
```

No configuration changes are required.
